name: Ardor3D PlyImporter
reason: JogAmp Javadoc documents a PlyImporter, but no tagged release contains it. As of 2026-11-18, Renanse/Ardor3D's newest tag is v1.6.0 (no PlyImporter in that repository), the JogAmp ardor3d.git refs list only the old v0.8 and v0.9 tags (the importer is in the 1.0-SNAPSHOT continuation), and Maven Central com.ardor3d stops at 1.0.0. The JogAmp tree pages sit behind a proof-of-work bot check, which was not bypassed. A pinned released artifact containing the importer remains unestablished.

name: ArtiSynth Maspack PlyReader
reason: The official 3.9 ZIP includes PlyReader source and compiled classes and a local-file API; a temporary control run parsed the ASCII triangle. However, its distribution LICENSE documents bundled TetGen restricted to noncommercial use. A separately released BSD-only Maspack PLY reader package has not been established, so the mixed-license distribution is not counted as an open-source package path.

name: JSplat jsplat-io-ply
reason: The publisher documents PlySplatReader.readList(InputStream) and the module depends on de.javagl:ply:0.0.4, sharing that underlying PLY reader family. The module POM is 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT, GitHub has no release tag, and no Maven Central release was found; a pinned open-source release and suitable ASCII Gaussian-splat control run are unestablished.

name: pcljava
reason: The README documents PointCloud3dReaderPly.read(local filename) over native PCL, but gives only 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT as a version and lists external PCL 1.11.1 native dependencies. The repository has no release tag or GitHub release, so a pinned released package, exact native graph, and ASCII control run are unestablished.

name: org.jorigin:jeometry-api 2.0.0 PLYReader
adoption_signal: deps.dev reported four known public direct dependents for exact Maven release 2.0.0 on 2026-11-13; excluded because the valid control did not parse.
reason: The tagged public PLYReader.read(File) called JeometryFactory.createPoint3DContainer, but the documented jeometry-simple implementation returns null from both container factory methods. On the valid ASCII triangle the reader threw IOException for the first vertex, caused by a null point container. The 1.0.5 tagged simple implementation has the same null methods. No format-aware control result was returned.

name: DirkToewe/sjmply
reason: GPL-3.0 repository documents PLY.load(Path) and property access, but GitHub exposes no tag or release; no pinned released library artifact or control run was established. This is a separate underlying parser lead.

name: cansik/pointcloud-processing PLYReader
reason: Tagged v0.2.0 reader wraps DirkToewe sjmply and has a local-file method, but the tagged tree has no license file and GitHub identifies no open-source license. No qualifying open-source package release or control result was established.

name: scalismo-faces_2.13 0.90.0
reason: unibas-gravis/scalismo-faces (123 stars, Apache-2.0) ships its own Scala PLY reader (scalismo.faces.io.ply.PlyMeshReader), but deps.dev records 0 direct dependents for the exact Maven Central releases ch.unibas.cs.gravis:scalismo-faces_2.13:0.90.0 and _2.12:0.90.0. A recorded zero is not a missing value, so the star fallback does not apply.
round6_note: The cell treats a recorded 0 as zero adoption (plan reason zero_recorded_adoption); the PLY star fallback applies only when the primary value is missing (null).

name: scalismo_2.13 0.91.1
reason: Earlier Scala 2.13 release line of the selected scalismo_3 path (1 deps.dev direct dependent). Its MeshIO.readPLY delegates to VTK vtkPLYReader through scalismo-native, not to the Scala reader counted for scalismo_3; the same project is counted once at its newest release.

name: ShapeNet/shapenet-viewer PLYLoader
reason: MIT application (190 stars, tag v0.1.0) with a jME3 AssetLoader, edu.stanford.graphics.shapenet.jme3.plugins.PLYLoader, that parses PLY through jPLY 0.2.0 (the jPLY family already counted via jzy3d-core). No library artifact is published. A check on 2026-11-18 covered the tag's pinned com.jme3 3.0.10 dependencies (jme3-core, -plugins, -effects, -jbullet, -niftygui, -desktop, -lwjgl): Maven Central has no com.jme3 group (org.jmonkeyengine starts at 3.1.0-alpha), jcenter.bintray.com redirects to Maven Central (404), maven.scijava.org, maven.imagej.net, jitpack.io and dl.bintray.com return 404, and jMonkeyEngine/jmonkeyengine has no 3.0.x tag or release asset. The Internet Archive holds listings and javadoc jars of the retired updates.jmonkeyengine.org/maven repository, but the service was offline during the check and an archived copy is not a registry release, so the tagged loader cannot be rebuilt as pinned.
discovery_route: GitHub code search PlyReader language:Java; dependency mirrors checked 2026-11-18

name: dbrant/ModelViewer3D PlyModel
reason: Apache-2.0 Android app (211 stars; tags are app versionCodes) whose PlyModel(InputStream) extends IndexedModel and imports android.opengl.GLES20 and Matrix. No JVM library artifact is published, and the parser is coupled to the Android runtime.

name: eqgis/Sceneform-EQR
reason: Apache-2.0 Android SDK (150 stars, tag v1.2.1) whose PLY support is the bundled C++ tinyply (Eq-Renderer/Android/eq-renderer/src/main/cpp/tinyply) behind JNI; it needs the Android runtime, and its parser is the tinyply family already counted in the C++ cell.

name: MarginallyClever/Robot-Overlord-App LoadPLY
reason: Despite its name, the tagged 3.118.0 com.marginallyclever.ro3.mesh.load.LoadPLY registers the csv extension and reads X,Y,Z,SIGNAL_STRENGTH comma-separated rows; it is not a PLY parser.

reason: Selected: separate unibas-gravis repository and artifact whose MeshIO.readMesh parses PLY through VTK vtkPLYReader (VTK 9.1 Java natives); 2 deps.dev direct dependents (scalismo-asm_3, scalismo-ui_3); pinned linux/amd64 Docker control (stock and VTK 9.1.0 coverage natives) and native IO/PLY AFL++ feedback passed.

name: edu.jhuapl.ses.vtk:vtk-java 9.2.6.0
reason: JHU APL's Maven Central packaging of the VTK 9.2.6 Java wrapper (MIT POM; vtk.vtkPLYReader in vtk-java-generic, natives in vtk-java-linux-x86-64, a fork of the vtkjavanatives loader in vtk-java-selector). Its POM SCM is a placeholder (https://placeholder.com/not-a-public-site.git): there is no public source repository, tag or documentation for the packaging. The deps.dev dependents of every artifact are only the packaging's own sibling artifacts (vtk-java-generic 6: the five platform jars and vtk-java-all; vtk-java-all 1: vtk-java-example), so no external adoption is recorded either. Not pursued; the VTK parser family is already represented by f3d and scalismo-vtk_3.
discovery_route: Maven Central search 'vtk' and classname search c:vtkPLYReader
